turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: That's the right qualifier. Reuters sourced this from people with knowledge of the matter — not a press release. So the numbers are reported, not confirmed by ByteDance directly.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: Which doesn't make them wrong. It makes them the most credible available reporting. The two-hundred-and-ninety-million figure and the one-point-five billion valuation are what we have.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: My question is who's in that two-hundred-and-ninety million. Because biotech AI investment has attracted a mix of genuinely long-horizon investors and people chasing the category regardless of the underlying science.
